notes: Harmony maker: in a deck's Stems tab, press Harmony, mark a line of the vocals (Use loop, or Start/End here) and add up to 4 voices (3rd/4th/5th/6th/octave above or below, or a double). Each follows the song's key note by note and glides between notes, keeps the singer's tone, sings with the lead or answers after (move it by beats), stacks 1-3 humanised takes panned left/right, with reverb, and becomes its own stem (mute/solo/volume, Mix tab, Premiere). Harmonies are remembered per song.
